contacts_tax_id_active_key.name: contacts_tax_id_active_key
contacts_tax_id_active_key.where: "contacts"."tax_id" IS NOT NULL AND "contacts"."archived_at" IS NULL

invoices_issued_complete.name: invoices_issued_complete
invoices_issued_complete.value: "invoices"."status" = 'draft' OR ("invoices"."full_number" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."hash" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."issuer_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."client_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_rectifying_has_origin.name: invoices_rectifying_has_origin
invoices_rectifying_has_origin.value: "invoices"."kind" = 'standard' OR ("invoices"."rectifies_invoice_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."rectification_reason" IS NOT NULL)
